kwargs.content:
You are analyzing a COMPLETE multi-page Proof of Delivery (POD) PDF packet in ONE request. Read every attached page and return JSON only. Do not invent values. T3RA Logistics is a broker, never the carrier.

Return exactly this top-level shape:
{
  "document_summary": {"page_count": 0, "page_types_seen": [], "notes": ""},
  "pages": [{
    "page_number": 1,
    "page_type": "BILL_OF_LADING"|"LUMPER_RECEIPT"|"ITEMIZED_LIST"|"RATE_CONFIRMATION"|"UNKNOWN",
    "fields": [{"key": "carrier_name"|"po_number"|"pickup_location"|"pickup_address"|"destination_location"|"destination_address"|"stamp_company_name", "value": "", "confidence": 1, "context_snippet": ""}],
    "pickup_details": {"location_name": "", "address": ""},
    "delivery_details": {"location_name": "", "address": ""},
    "reference_ids": [{"label": "PO#"|"Customer PO#"|"BOL#"|"Pickup#"|"Pickup Appointment #"|"Delivery#"|"Delivery Appointment #", "value": ""}],
    "proof_of_receipt": {"has_receiver_signature": false, "receiver_signature_location": "N/A", "has_stamp": false, "has_delivery_sticker": false, "delivery_number": "", "delivery_confirmation_reasoning": ""},
    "signature_owner": "receiver"|"shipper"|"driver"|"carrier"|"unknown",
    "pallets_shipped": null, "damage_detected": false, "damage_detail": "",
    "stop_times": [{"pickup_checkin_time": "", "pickup_checkout_time": "", "delivery_checkin_time": "", "delivery_checkout_time": ""}]
  }],
  "reconciled": {"fields": [], "proof_of_receipt": {}, "stop_times": [], "delivery_confirmed": false}
}

Rules:
1. Include every page independently. Values on a page must be visibly present on that page.
2. Extract every exact labeled reference ID, preserving leading zeroes.
3. Extract the visibly printed Shipper/From/Origin block into pickup_details and the Consignee/To/Destination block into delivery_details. A BOL may contain both blocks; return both.
4. Do NOT decide whether a page belongs to pickup or delivery. Turvo owns that decision after it matches an extracted PO to its stop.
5. receiver signature/stamp/sticker evidence counts only when its printed label identifies a Receiver/Consignee/RECVR field. Driver or carrier signatures do not count as receiver proof. A stamp stating Received, Cleared, Delivered, or Delivery Confirmed is delivery evidence.
6. Extract check-in and check-out times only when visibly printed. Put each time under the printed pickup or delivery label. Use ISO 8601 UTC when the document provides enough date/timezone information; otherwise leave it blank rather than guessing.
7. Extract damage, shortage, refusal, and claim notation per page.
8. Rate confirmation pages are RATE_CONFIRMATION only when explicitly titled Rate Confirmation.
9. reconciled is document summary only. Do not use it to merge, reassign, or infer page ownership.
10. Return JSON only.

kwargs.template: Analyze the attached complete POD PDF across all pages and return the JSON schema above.
